up: Retrieve all activity records for the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4649961'. For each compound, return the exact activity values (including standard_type, standard_relation (where relation is '='), standard_value, and standard_units) and the canonical SMILES from the compound structure. Include only records where the activity measurement is exact (i.e., standard_relation = '=').
sql:
SELECT a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649961'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
